rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved programs; Category I CME courses focused on pharmacy, pharmacology or drug therapy; Board-approved programs (1.5 CEUs = 15 contact hours)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pharmacists first licensed in the year before the renewal date are exempt at that first renewal; licenses issued on or after October 1 first renew December 31 of the next year.
rules.alternatives: Up to 2 hours for volunteer pharmacy services (1 hour per 3 hours). Pharmacists also licensed elsewhere who met 15 hours there need no more. Extensions/exemptions possible.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; Board may audit the past two years. Keep original certificates 2 years.
rules.notes: Licenses expire December 31 and renew annually; renewal also needs an NABP e-profile number. At least 3 of the 15 hours must be live or real-time interactive.
rules.rule_quote: A pharmacist shall be required to have completed a minimum of 1.5 CEUs or 15 contact hours of continuing pharmacy education in an approved program for each annual renewal of licensure.
